busy_cancel_note: "Includes PyMOL™" mode cannot interrupt a running request, so it is rebuilt and the last checkpoint restored; changes after it may be lost. With no checkpoint, the structure is reloaded and changes since it opened may be lost (the view is put back).
detail_export_expired: the answer of "Includes PyMOL™" mode came after its deadline, so it was not taken
detail_export_refused: what "Includes PyMOL™" mode sent back had the wrong shape, so it was not taken
detail_frame_gone: the view of "Includes PyMOL™" mode was rebuilt or closed
export_err_no_sele: There is no current selection (sele). Click or drag over atoms in "Includes PyMOL™" mode, then press again.
export_err_not_file: What "Includes PyMOL™" mode returned was not a {{format}} file, so nothing was saved.
export_err_unknown_selection: "Includes PyMOL™" mode could not read this selection: {{detail}}
export_err_unknown_selection_bare: "Includes PyMOL™" mode could not read this selection.
export_note_v2: Saves atoms now in "Includes PyMOL™" mode to this computer as a PDB, mmCIF, SDF or MOL2 file. The coordinates are those of the current state (the one shown). The file is not sent to AgDB.
export_queued_note: The export has not started: "Includes PyMOL™" mode is still running a request made earlier. You can close the dialog; the export is then withdrawn, no file is saved and nothing in "Includes PyMOL™" mode is lost.
export_small_note: Bond orders and charges in an SDF or MOL2 file are as "Includes PyMOL™" mode read them. Nothing is added or corrected. A ligand read from a structure file (PDB, mmCIF) usually carries no bond orders, so its bonds are all written as single bonds.
export_target_ligand: Ligands (the selection keyword organic: small molecules, no water or ions)
export_target_sele_note: What you selected in "Includes PyMOL™" mode by clicking or dragging over atoms.
export_waiting_note: The export has not started: "Includes PyMOL™" mode is finishing a load requested earlier (for example an added structure, a pose, a density map or a session). This wait cannot be stopped, but you can close the dialog; the export is then withdrawn and no file is saved.
export_why_close_busy: "Includes PyMOL™" mode is running a request, so this dialog cannot close. “{{stop}}” rebuilds it and cancels this export; anything waiting stops too.
export_withdrawn: Molecule export withdrawn: the dialog closed before "Includes PyMOL™" mode got to it, so no file was saved.
keys_escape: Esc: toggles the text panel of "Includes PyMOL™" mode (as in desktop PyMOL™).
keys_function: F1-F12: recall the scenes F1-F12 of "Includes PyMOL™" mode (as in desktop PyMOL™).
keys_note: Chrome on Windows takes these shortcuts of "Includes PyMOL™" mode for itself, so they never reach this page. Press them with Alt added instead, after clicking into its view. On other systems the desktop may take the chord with Alt added first (Ctrl+Alt+T or Ctrl+Alt+F4 on Linux, for example). On a keyboard layout that types characters with AltGr, the same keys pressed with AltGr also reach "Includes PyMOL™" mode as these shortcuts.
keys_tab: Tab / Shift+Tab: move focus out of the view of "Includes PyMOL™" mode (not sent to it).
measure_hint: Start the Measurement wizard of "Includes PyMOL™" mode: click two atoms for a distance
measure_locked_not_ready: Available once "Includes PyMOL™" mode is ready
measure_locked_other_wizard: Another wizard is open in "Includes PyMOL™" mode: close it first
menu_locked_not_ready: Available once "Includes PyMOL™" mode is ready.
preset_note_bfactor: B-factor: blue = low (well placed), white = middle, red = high (mobile). The colour range is that of the backbone CA atoms. A structure with no CA atoms, or with the same value on every CA, is left as it is, and "Includes PyMOL™" mode says why at the top left of its view.
preset_note_ligand_site: Ligand site: the target is your selection (sele), else the previous target, else the only ligand. When none decides it, nothing changes and "Includes PyMOL™" mode says why at the top left of its view. Otherwise every atom's representations are hidden, and only these are shown again: the target and the residues within 5 Å (side chains and CA) as sticks, the target's carbons in yellow and the other elements in their own colours, waters in that range as spheres, polar contacts as dashes, labels with residue name, number and chain, and the protein as a cartoon. Everything else stays hidden, metal ions and other ligands near the target included. Cartoon transparency is set to half for the whole scene.
preset_note_plddt: pLDDT: dark blue = above 90 (very high), light blue = 70-90 (confident), yellow = 50-70 (low), orange = below 50 (very low). A structure with no CA atoms, or whose CA values all lie between 0 and 1 (not a pLDDT on the 0-100 scale), is left as it is, and "Includes PyMOL™" mode says why at the top left of its view.
preset_note_pocket: Pocket surface: the target is your selection (sele), else the previous target, else the only ligand. When none decides it, nothing changes and "Includes PyMOL™" mode says why at the top left of its view. Otherwise every surface is hidden except that of the residues within 6 Å of the target, and the target shows as sticks, its carbons in yellow and the other elements in their own colours; other representations stay as they were. Surface transparency is set to half and two-sided lighting turned on for the whole scene, not only for this surface.
preset_note_reset: Every molecule is drawn again in the usual representations of a load — cartoon for protein, sticks for ligands, spheres for ions, lines and crosses for water — with each element in its own colour and carbons in the molecule's colour. This is not a record of how the structure or session first looked: labels and surfaces you added go, and the view frames the whole structure. The background goes back to black, and these nine settings to the defaults of "Includes PyMOL™" mode, values you set yourself included: transparency, cartoon transparency, two-sided lighting, shadows, depth cue, ray-trace fog, antialiasing, ray-trace opaque background and fancy helices. Other settings stay as they are. The dashes and selections Drug discovery made are gone; density meshes and other measurements stay.
pse_export_err_not_file: "Includes PyMOL™" mode returned no session data, so nothing was saved.
pse_export_note: Saves everything now in "Includes PyMOL™" mode — the structures, how they are shown, the selections, the scenes and the settings — as one session file (.pse) on this computer. Desktop PyMOL™ opens it. The file is not sent to AgDB.
pse_export_queued_note: The save has not started: "Includes PyMOL™" mode is still running a request made earlier. You can close the dialog; the save is then withdrawn, no file is saved and nothing in "Includes PyMOL™" mode is lost.
pse_export_title: Save the session of "Includes PyMOL™" mode (.pse)
pse_export_waiting_note: The save has not started: "Includes PyMOL™" mode is finishing a load requested earlier (for example an added structure, a pose, a density map or a session). This wait cannot be stopped, but you can close the dialog; the save is then withdrawn and no file is saved.
pse_export_warn: Desktop PyMOL™ can run code inside a .pse file when it opens one. This file is made fresh by "Includes PyMOL™" mode from what it holds now; still, open a .pse you receive only when it comes from someone you trust.
pse_export_withdrawn: Session save withdrawn: the dialog closed before "Includes PyMOL™" mode got to it, so no file was saved.
ray_create_not_ready: "Includes PyMOL™" mode is not ready (it is starting, restarting or saving another image). Create becomes available when it is ready.
ray_dialog_note: "Includes PyMOL™" mode ray-traces the current view with these settings. The image downloads as soon as it is ready and is stored in the screenshot/pose history.
ray_time_note_v2: A larger size or high antialiasing takes longer: 2x the view takes about 4 times as long as the view's size, and high antialiasing several times more. A ray that runs past 10 minutes is stopped, and "Includes PyMOL™" mode is restarted from its last automatic snapshot.
ray_time_risky: This may take about {{min}} minutes or more and could pass the 10-minute limit. Past it the ray is stopped and "Includes PyMOL™" mode is restarted, which can undo recent changes. Pick a smaller size or lower antialiasing to be safe.
settings_scale_note: Change this if the text of "Includes PyMOL™" mode looks too small or too large at a Windows display scale such as 125 % or 150 %. Kept in this browser only.
settings_set_note: Current values are not shown here (nothing is read out of the view of "Includes PyMOL™" mode). Run get <name> in the command line to see one in its own output.
